result.topic_en: This is an envelope addressed to Gauss in Göttingen, apparently from a Dr Hoefer. Its flap carries numerical jottings: residues grouped by an index 2–9, a small table in columns headed p and l, and the expressions l-1, l+3-2p and l+1-p.
result.transcription:
Dr Hoefer[?], Passage Tivoli[?] No 14
A Monsieur
Monsieur Ch. Fr. Gauss
à Göttingue

[stamp:] NIEDERSÄCHS. STAATS- U. UNIV. BIBLIOTHEK GÖTTINGEN

[on flap:]
2 29
3 9.10.3.22.15.11
4 5.2.23.20.19.17.16.13.27.28
5 6.26.24.21.14.12
6 7.25
7 4.1
8 8
9

p l
3 3 1
4 [-..-] 5[?] 2
5 [-..-] 7[?] 3

[square with diagonal cross]

$l-1$
$l+3-2p$
$l+1-p$

[pencil, later hand:]
14.28 54.35
45.12 29.26

methods.what: Numbers 1–29 grouped into classes labelled 2 to 9, apparently a classification of residues modulo 29
Small table of corresponding values in columns headed p and l
Linear expressions in l and p, possibly counts associated with the table
